messages.text:
Cool. Thanks for the clarification.  All is working now and I'm going to get a spare lilygo to load the Harlo OS to preserve the Hammer default Norn OS.  I'll let you know how it goes.

Dean

Hi Dean,

Glad it's sorted, and that's a smart way to do it. Keeping the stock Hammer firmware on the original board and flashing Harlo OS to a spare LilyGo means you can switch back any time.

Downloads, release notes and the flashing guide all live at https://harlolabs.com/ , so grab the newest build for your board from there rather than an older image.

Do let me know how it goes. If you hit anything odd, our Discord is the fastest place for help: https://discord.gg/Q2R5sA9Fsf , post there and mention @nullhashrate (JD).

Happy to have helped. If you were pleased with the service, a review on Trustpilot would mean a lot to us: https://www.trustpilot.com/review/heliumdeploy.com

Sarah, HeliumDeploy
